text:
Type: five-tier ladder bookcase
Use: storing books and display items; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, classic, mid-century modern
Materials: solid rubber wood, walnut stain
Colors: dark warm walnut brown
Shape: tall leaning ladder frame, five shelves widening toward the bottom, open back and sides, slim and light
Feel: warm, airy, simple
Goes with: cream walls, warm wood, brass accents; classic or modern rooms

product.name: AmazonBasics Classic 5-Tier Open Bookcase with Solid Rubber Wood - Walnut
product.description: 5-tier classic ladder-style bookcase for placing keepsakes, decor, books, awards, and more Descending design with shelf widths widening at the bottom Straight back allows you to place bookcase neatly against a wall; angled front saves space Solid rubber wood construction; each shelf holds 25 pounds Minimal, modern design complements a variety of interior aesthetics Easy to assemble with provided instructions and hardware
